entries.label: Critical Execution (Strike)
entries.description: Strikes the target for 666 Physical damage plus 66% of your attack power. This total is increased by 1% per Paragon level.
entries.review_note: DBC-only helper remains exposed in the legacy picker. Replace the literal Unknown String with the C++ formula; do not add a sparse DB override.

entries.label: HoTs 2x
entries.description: Increases the amount of periodic healing from your affected spells by 100%.
entries.review_note: Current operation is SPELLMOD_DOT +100%, not doubled tick rate and duration as concept/source comments claim.
